1: // Orbit Runner – minimal implementation
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // ----- Game entities -----
11:   const ship = {
12:     x: W / 2,
13:     y: H / 2,
14:     r: 10,
15:     angle: 0,
16:     vx: 0,
17:     vy: 0,
18:     thrust: 0.1,
19:     turnSpeed: 0.07,
20:     fuel: 100,
21:   };
22: 
23:   const asteroids = [];
24:   const asteroidCount = 8;
25:   const center = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2 };
26:   for (let i = 0; i < asteroidCount; i++) {
27:     const radius = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
28:     const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / asteroidCount;
29:     const speed = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4;
30:     asteroids.push({ radius, angle, speed, r: 15 + Math.random() * 10 });
31:   }
32: 
33:   const fuels = [];
34:   const fuelCount = 5;
35:   for (let i = 0; i < fuelCount; i++) {
36:     fuels.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, r: 6, value: 30 });
37:   }
38: 
39:   // ----- Input -----
40:   const keys = {};
41:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
42:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
43: 
44:   // ----- Helpers -----
45:   function circleCollision(ax, ay, ar, bx, by, br) {
46:     const dx = ax - bx;
47:     const dy = ay - by;
48:     return dx * dx + dy * dy < (ar + br) * (ar + br);
49:   }
50: 
51:   // ----- Main loop -----
52:   let gameOver = false;
53:   function update() {
54:     if (gameOver) return;
55:     // controls
56:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.turnSpeed;
57:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.turnSpeed;
58:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
59:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
60:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
61:       ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - 0.2);
62:     }
63:     // fuel drain over time
64:     ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - 0.05);
65:     // move ship
66:     ship.x += ship.vx;
67:     ship.y += ship.vy;
68:     // simple friction
69:     ship.vx *= 0.99;
70:     ship.vy *= 0.99;
71:     // wrap around edges
72:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += W;
73:     if (ship.x > W) ship.x -= W;
74:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += H;
75:     if (ship.y > H) ship.y -= H;
76: 
77:     // update asteroids (orbit around center)
78:     for (const a of asteroids) {
79:       a.angle += a.speed * 0.01;
80:       a.x = center.x + Math.cos(a.angle) * a.radius;
81:       a.y = center.y + Math.sin(a.angle) * a.radius;
82:       // collision with ship
83:       if (circleCollision(ship.x, ship.y, ship.r, a.x, a.y, a.r)) {
84:         gameOver = true;
85:       }
86:     }
87: 
88:     // fuel cells collection
89:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
90:       const f = fuels[i];
91:       if (circleCollision(ship.x, ship.y, ship.r, f.x, f.y, f.r)) {
92:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + f.value);
93:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
94:       }
95:     }
96:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
97:   }
98: 
99:   function draw() {
100:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
101:     // ship
102:     ctx.save();
103:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
104:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
105:     ctx.beginPath();
106:     ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
107:     ctx.lineTo(-8, -6);
108:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 6);
109:     ctx.closePath();
110:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
111:     ctx.fill();
112:     ctx.restore();
113:     // asteroids
114:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
115:     for (const a of asteroids) {
116:       ctx.beginPath();
117:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
118:       ctx.fill();
119:     }
120:     // fuel cells
121:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
122:     for (const f of fuels) {
123:       ctx.beginPath();
124:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
125:       ctx.fill();
126:     }
127:     // UI
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
129:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
130:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 20);
131:     if (gameOver) {
132:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
133:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
134:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 120, H / 2);
135:     }
136:   }
137: 
138:   function loop() {
139:     update();
140:     draw();
141:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
142:   }
143:   loop();
144: })();

(End of file - total 144 lines)
